_doc: The prebuilt release player variants (docs/specs/S34-player-size.md R4, D2): each a set of the optional
engine modules (core/player/PlayerModules.h). CMake builds one with -DJASPERENGINE_PLAYER_VARIANT=<name>
the full player's the plain one. tools/build.sh players and CI build every variant of the release flavour;
the development flavour is the full player. A build uses the smallest installed variant whose modules hold
every module its project needs (editor/players/ModuleUsage). Listed from the largest to the smallest: of two
variants with as many modules, the later one is the smaller (the measurements of the S34 spec, M8).
